title: WearOS graph Plugin Glucose?
body:
On the phone:
xDrip  - Menu - Less Common Settings - Advanced Calibration

Calibration Plugin: Datricsae
Use Plugin Glucose : ON

The readings on WearOS watch doesn't match with the phone, I assume that is not using Plugin Glucose. Is that right?

![1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/608650/73729898-c4424800-472d-11ea-8060-b0957b180f2d.PNG)

comments.body: I received feedback that Plugin Glucose is not sent to Nightscout. But I didn't check it yet.

@parapenT1sta I experienced similar problems with Jan 29 build. Had upgraded to the G6 (8H series) transmitter and sensor. Upgrade appeared to go fine. After phone got readings, I switched it to my watch as collector (Force Wear Collection). Eventually my phone's xDrip Home screen display showed that it was not receiving data (old reading/number with line through it). However, my Zenwatch2 was still receiving data AND the xDrip status page showed watch regularly receiving data. It just wasn't displaying on the xdrip home screen. This had been working fine with a G5 transmitter/sensor. If I switched to phone as collector, the readings were fine and it sent them to my watch but the arrows didn't match. Unfortunately, I did not capture screen shots or logs. (Not for this issue: I have since uninstalled xdrip, cleared all the cache, factory reset my phone, re-installed latest nightly xdrip and am now having problems with xdrip "seeing" my G6 transmitter)

> I received feedback that Plugin Glucose is not sent to Nightscout. But I didn't check it yet.

I can confirm that xdrip plugin wasnt uploading the same value to nightscout.

![Screenshot_20200204_215152_com android chrome_resize_91](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/48919798/73799212-35751000-47ad-11ea-97d0-ae013b41a49e.jpg)  ![Screenshot_20200204_215139_com eveningoutpost dexdrip_resize_71](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/48919798/73799218-37d76a00-47ad-11ea-81c3-4a98186d1d4d.jpg)
I used a similar setup and had the same issue but no solution. See #692

@parapenT1sta 
Is this not related to the following?
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/595

If yes, would you please post in that issue and request it to be reopened if you still have the problem?
It seems but the ticket is closed and the issue still persists.
